notes.title: v1.035 Tiny shop update
notes.notes:
A little fix to shops:

 Spells that you already have won't appear in a shop anymore
 Now traders will also buy your tiles, not only sell or exchange them

notes.title: v1.020 - BIG balance update!
notes.notes:
Attention to people with current saves:
Since I'm not a great coder, I couldn't make this update 100% smooth. That means some features will appear right in your current run, and others will be applied only when you finish it. Sorry for that ːhappy_yetiː

In the current run:

 Rebalance of EXP, gold, and chests (rewards and prices) to make it enough at the start, but not that abundant in the late-game 
 Now M and L mission has 1-2 chests (not always 2, as earlier)
 More and better choices in shops + Reroll button + Upgrades for 2-3 copies of one unit.
 Orc bosses are buffed
 Orc Werewolf terrain preferences changed (+ forests)
 Crossbowman terrain preferences changed (like a Rouge)
 Enemy Summoner units (Necromancer, Satyr Druid, and Orc Shaman) are buffed in the Act 3
 Corrode Armor spell mana cost -1
 Skill trees: you can't buy a negative skill if you have no exp for the following positive one
 Performance optimization
 Bug fixes


After you finish it:

 Skill trees EXP prices tweaks (cheaper start skills, more expensive top skills)
 Skill trees for Brevnio Returned, Tosha, and Carl got some rework
 Lower exp requirements for all heroes' levels (except Alma)
 Easier unlock quests of Timeless One and Carl
 Boss prizes are depends on the Act number

notes.title: v1.002 - Important fix for those who played DEMO before the release
notes.notes:
As you probably noticed, your saves from the demo are transferred to the full version. But there was a bug in the transfer - you didn't get quests for all new heroes. 
Now it's fixed and uploaded! Update the game and see new quests when you finish your current run.

I wanted to say thanks to all who played the demo! ːlove_seagullː
You maybe know, in the full version Brevnio Returned has a very rare quest to be unlocked. As a special sign of appreciation, I didn't remove the easy quest for her for the demo players. ːhappy_yetiː

notes.title: 1.000 - RELEASE update!
notes.notes:
OHHH, I'm SO EXCITED! ːsteamhappyː 
Hope you guys enjoy it, it was long 4 years (or maybe 5, I can't count right now)
Let's see what I've done for the 1.0 version:

[olist]
 All 8 heroes, with very special skill trees and playstyles.
 All 8 bosses!
 EASY MODE! If something goes wrong, you can press undo on the auto phase (but before enemy spawns)
 Added much more sounds and a few great soundtracks
 Localizations! (new Italian and Spanish are here, German is coming soon)
 Fixes!
 Rebalances!
 Improvements!
[/olist]

notes.title: 0.980 - Pre-prelease update!
notes.notes:
Cannons fix - I had to disable two units out of the game due to bugs. Now they are back
 Brute bugfix - he used to freeze the game. He promised never to do it again
 More fine sound volume settings
 Better French localization - thanks to the player iXeRay
 Bugfixes!


And not for demo: +7 bossfights and +2 heroes

notes.title: v0.970 - FEST update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41811152/9ec665d00b24ba55c0ced3e14f84bc235d83651e.png

 Steam Cloud saves! ːballoonicornː
 Better Steamdeck support (buttons glyphs, resolution)
 Importing your language from Steam settings
 3 more soundtracks (one epic, specifically for bossfights ) + more sounds
 One more achievement - to test your skills ːcool_seagullː
 Improved Map, Hand and Quit screens
 Better map generation for defence missions
 Better Chinese localization

notes.title: v0.960 - UNITS update + lots more
notes.notes:
NEW UNITS (like +30 or more) 
HUGE UNIT REBALANCE (I mean a huge rebalance of units. But wait, now there are huge units too! ːTheDivineRedCrownː)

Also: 
 Map tiles repainted, because you deserve the best
 Better tutorial texts
 Detailed view now can be shown on all screens
 Setting for animation speed in the main menu (not for newbies!)
 New unit attributes for new units: Attack everyone, Summon instead of attack, Terrain protection
 A couple of new spells
 Mission goals are now shown on the Map screen
 You now risk 2-4 ː8bitheartː depending on a mission size (instead of a fixed 3ː8bitheartː)
 Two more soundtracks for thoughtful playing
 Some spells can target bosses
 GUI improvements and bugfixes everywhere

notes.title: v0.907 - QoL update!
notes.notes:
Easier missions for newbies ːcoolstar2022ː
 Better readability of global map and skill tree screens
 Better scaling of mouse cursor and tutorial windows for 4K screens
 Some feats and spells got more clear descriptions
 Bugfixes here and there (EVERYWHERE!)

notes.title: v0.900 - SHOPPING update!
notes.notes:
Shops are finally open! Gold is finally not useless in the game ːcoolstar2022ː
There are 4 different traders you can meet on your journey: merchant, blacksmith, arcanist, and mysterious.
And this was the last big feature I had to make. 
Now I plan to relax and chill, while making BALANCE, BOSSFIGHTS, and BUGFIXES ːhappy_yetiː

notes.title: v0.820 - TREASURE update! (NEW MISSION MODE)
notes.notes:
New mission mode - CAPTURE. Grab as many chests as you can. No need to protect anyone
 Achievements
 Enemies won't spawn next to your civilians anymore
 More clear UI
 Small fixes here and there

notes.title: v0.800 - BABYLONICAL update!
notes.notes:
Some guys in ancient Babylon did something, and because of them now I must do all that stuff with translations, localizations, finding new fonts, and so on ːsteamboredː

BUT I DID! ːcoolstar2022ː Those are 100% guaranteed not precise translations. Lots of auto translators used and died for this. But I hope it's now more comfortable to play in 11 more languages.

If you can help me with your language in the game - I'll be happy to receive all the help you provide. ːhappy_yetiː

notes.title: v0.755 - Feedbackical update!
notes.notes:
ːcoolstar2022ː Thanks for filling out the feedback form, it really helps!

A few tune-ups based on your messages:

 Perk view mode - hold ALT or a middle mouse button to view all the perks,  "in your face" style ːlunar2019grinningpigː
 Hotkeys, deselection with the right mouse button
 Units spawned by the "Spawn after death" feat won't act immediately
 Balance adjustments for fresh players
 Bugfixes!

notes.title: v0.750 - JUICY update + DEMO OUT!
notes.notes:
I made some visual updates here and there, everything is much juicier and smoother.
 To celebrate this, here's a new trailer!
 And to celebrate a new trailer, a DEMO is out now! ːhappy_yetiː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41811152/b98e11019059e01049aaa1855cae973a406694fc.jpg
Well, the demo isn't full featured yet (you can always read my to do list right in the game), but it shows everything you could see in a full game. Except shops, that's for a dessert.

notes.title: v0.730 - DEFENSIVE update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41811152/ac121e501c908a9d19e4fb83fd49617d97a5f0d9.png
New mission mode - DEFENSE - now your civilians are static and the enemy is assaulting them
Talkies - units are now talking!

Optimization for potato PCs
Bugfixes and better visuals of menus between battles.

notes.title: v0.700 - Playtest opened + MAGICAL update
notes.notes:
There's a first playtest version so that everyone can play it. And test it! ːhappy_yetiː


 I've put my hands elbow-deep into magic and made 40+ new spells for a game. Now there are 50 of them
 Two heroes with very different playstyles
 Balance in campaigns
 Bossfight - only one type of boss for now, and I'm not sure how balanced it is yet
 Bugfixes, bugfixes everywhere
